_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. www.hbomax.com's own token sheet declares the --color_* semantic roles (kept under dark.color.*) and the --spacer-*/--border-*/--font_* scales (kept under core.*, each breakpoint step as .bpNN — resolved at 1440px). "var" leaves resolve through the live document; "value" leaves are measured.
